notes: Vita Link Staff profile and tablet portal workflow patch.
Restores Profile Dashboard search, tag selection availability, matching gender options, and The Spot restricted action.
Makes Mass Email and Intake dashboard launches visible and error-reporting from the main dashboard.
Deduplicates tablet/phone event purpose options and event attendance lists.
Automatically adds youth to an event roster when an approved or merged check-in includes that event as the visit purpose.
Adds youth search and add-to-roster controls to tablet/phone event attendance.
Builds on Vita Nova Staff 1.0.122 and keeps the current staff functionality intact.
